item.title: Solo Art Exhibition Series
item.description: Misk Art Institute presents the third edition of the Solo Series, spotlighting established Saudi artists Fouad Mougharbel and Saad Almasari, whose work has contributed significantly to the Kingdom’s evolving visual culture. Through two individual exhibitions—“Taibah: Remnants and Solace” by Dr. Fouad Mougharbel and “Geometry as Thought” by Saad Almasari—the series offers insight into their artistic journeys and practices, reflecting their sustained engagement with the local art scene. Together, the exhibitions highlight diverse perspectives and approaches that contribute to shaping Saudi Arabia’s contemporary artistic identity. Alongside the exhibitions, a curated public program provides opportunities for deeper engagement: Exhibition Program: May 6: Artist Signing with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel & Saad Almasari | 7 PM May 7: Curator-Led Tour | 6 – 7 PM Artist Talk with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel | 8 – 8:45 PM Artist Talk with Saad Almasari | 9 – 9:45 PM May 9 Workshop: Exhibition Design | 7 – 9 PM May 9 – 11 Intensive Workshop: Pattern Design (Inspired by Saad Almasari) | 7 – 9 PM. May 16: Artist in Focus: Saad Almasari | 7 – 9 PM June 3: Curator-Led Virtual Tour | 7 – 8 PM For the latest updates and announcements, follow their official X account @MiskArtInst

item.title: Art Futures Camp 2026 – Diriyah Art Futures
item.description: Art Futures Summer Camp for Arabic-Speaking Teens is a three-week immersive programme hosted by Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), the MENA region’s first centre dedicated to New Media Arts. Designed for Arabic-speaking teens aged 14–18, the camp offers an in-depth introduction to digital art practices in a dynamic and supportive environment. Under the 2026 theme, “Digital Art and Portraiture,” participants explore new ways of representing identity in the digital age, questioning how individuals are portrayed when faces become data and images circulate beyond physical presence. The programme combines creative experimentation with foundational technical skills, including Fab Lab practices and digital studio portraiture. Throughout the camp, participants work closely with industry specialists and creative mentors, culminating in a collaborative exhibition produced with DAF’s curatorial and exhibition teams to showcase their work. Applications are officially open, with aspiring young creatives in Riyadh able to apply until Sunday, June 7.

item.title: SAIF Summer Program
item.description: SAIF 2026 is a summer creative program presented by SAMoCA at JAX, offering a diverse range of workshops, film screenings, and interactive activities for children, teenagers, and young audiences. The program features hands-on experiences in ceramics, fashion and tailoring, papermaking, photography, writing, voiceover, and other creative disciplines. Developed in collaboration with cultural and educational partners, SAIF encourages artistic expression, creativity, and cultural discovery through engaging learning experiences. Hosted at SAMoCA at JAX in the JAX District, Diriyah, the program provides an inspiring environment where visitors can explore Saudi creativity, develop new skills, and participate in a vibrant community of art and culture.

item.title: Your Book in a Minute!
item.description: This program presents an exciting and challenging experience, where participants have only one minute to talk about their favorite book. Are you ready to be part of this fun literary experience?

item.title: Tales of the Night Sky (English)
item.description: This magical Mommy and Me experience invites families on a journey through the night sky, beginning with a storytime inspired by traditional Arab tales of the constellations. After the story, we will design constellation cards featuring their favorite star patterns, blending creativity with storytelling. The morning will end with a shared breakfast, offering a special moment to connect, reflect and enjoy quality time together.

item.title: Take a closer look at the preparation process for the plays competing
item.description: In this session, we will take a closer look at the preparation process for the plays competing in the Ithra’s Short Play Contest. Join us to learn more about the preparation process and meet some of the participants in contest 6th edition.

item.title: الأسبوع الصيني
item.description: اكتشف الأسبوع الصيني، فعالية ثقافية ترفيهية تستعرض الفنون والتجارب الصينية في أجواء عصرية، تبرز التقارب بين الثقافتين السعودية والصينية.

item.title: Reading Between the Image and the Story
item.description: A literary dialogue that explores what happens when the painter's brush meets the writer's pen, and how images can captivate a child's imagination, inspiring them with a passion for reading and understanding deep meanings.

item.title: Energy Lab
item.description: Join us in our Energy Lab, where your curious minds can expand and explore the wonders of scientific and engineering ideas! Here, you can conduct crazy experiments and share knowledge with like-minded friends.

item.title: Survival Journey
item.description: How can we adapt to our environment using the energy around us? How do elements of nature become sources that support our daily lives? Join us in an interactive experience where we explore how nature’s challenges can transform into useful sources of life. We observe, experiment, and imagine how certain solutions can become sustainable for the natural world.

item.title: Idea Lab Majlis
item.description: Join us at our monthly Idea Lab Societies gathering, a collaborative space for design professionals, practitioners and enthusiasts. Engage with peers from various disciplines for an evening of inspiration, brainstorming, and insightful discussions. We invite you to share your creative perspectives and explore new possibilities!

item.title: Hobby with Expert: Health and Sports
item.description: In a world where health and sports intersect and opinions differ, join us on a journey to separate fact from fiction and uncover the truth together.

item.title: Chess Hub
item.description: Compete with your friends on the chessboard! Have fun with pawns and knights, develop your chess skills, or learn the basics of the game with us through a story. Encourage your little ones to play chess or challenge your friends in a weekly meeting at the Ithra Library.

item.title: SWIM-R Mission
item.description: Are you up for a challenge? Join us at the Energy Exhibit and don’t miss the chance to program and code the robot to reach the end of the maze and accomplish the mission!

item.title: Energy in Motion
item.description: Imagine a world where energy transforms from one form to another, setting objects into motion and spin. How does movement begin? How does it transfer? What makes some objects spin faster or stronger? Join us for an experience where you explore scientific ideas through fun, hands-on motion activities that reveal the secrets of rotation and energy transfer in the systems around us.

item.title: Nu-Power
item.description: What happens when a small trigger ignites a big reaction? How can stored energy expand, move and transform before our eyes? Join us in a fun and safe interactive experience where we observe surprising reactions and share our predictions, as we explore how energy can remain stored and then burst into rapid and striking transformations.

item.title: The Moral of the Story
item.description: It's story time! Enjoy new stories full of events and adventures, each of which leads you to a vast world filled with new words and ideas. Join us as we explore the moral of the book, form our own perspectives and discuss our takes on plot events and characters. Don’t miss this unique experience to find something different within each story.

item.title: The Non-Stop Spin
item.description: Can energy work in ways we never expected? Join us in an exciting interactive experience where we discover how a unique form of energy can create motion and rotation in surprising ways. We build, test and observe how energy transforms into movement right before our eyes. This experience invites you to think differently and look around you with greater curiosity to discover unfamiliar energy sources that may be closer than we imagine. Get ready to explore, experiment and see motion from a whole new perspective!

item.title: Connect and Create!
item.description: How can a simple movement extend across an entire form? How does motion travel through connected parts to create a balanced and elegant transformation? Join us in an interactive experience where we explore how linked structures expand and contract to create smooth movement with minimal effort. We build, test and observe how motion spreads through a form to create transforming patterns that bring together science, design and art.

item.title: Ithra Readers Club
item.description: Ithra Readers Club is an enriching youth forum where books from a variety of fields are discussed in public each month. The club aims to create a reader-friendly community and encourage discussions and analysis of serious books in a stimulating and liberating atmosphere. The books have been chosen by a committee from the Ithra Library team and have been approved by members before official club events. Today’s reader is tomorrow's leader. item.title: Hobby with Expert: Translation
item.description: How can a translated word change your understanding of the world? Join us with an expert who discusses this and shares her creative journey.

item.title: The Orbits of Arabic Calligraphy
item.description: The program vision: This program begins with a deep understanding that Arabic calligraphy is not isolated, but it is integrated and interacts with various domains. Arabic calligraphy is an aesthetic and intellectual system, combining rhythm, construction and symbols. Moreover, it has a unique ability to transform into a variety of art mediums. This sophisticated program views Arabic calligraphy as more than just typography, it sees the powerful elements utilized to modify it into a key component of contemporary art and cultural projects.
